annotations.title: Add a brand's own sending domain

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Registers the brand's `domain` (e.g. example.com) for sending. Returns its status; the DNS records to publish are in brand_sending_identity_get. Nothing is sent from the domain until it is verified.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands/{id}/sending-identity/domain.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_sending_domain_add
title: Add a brand's own sending domain
